commands.command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 700 /etc/fleet-pki/private
sudo install -d -m 755 /etc/fleet-pki/certs
if [ ! -s /etc/fleet-pki/private/fleet-internal-ca.key ]; then
  sudo openssl genrsa -out /etc/fleet-pki/private/fleet-internal-ca.key 3072
  sudo chmod 600 /etc/fleet-pki/private/fleet-internal-ca.key
fi
if [ ! -s /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt ]; then
  sudo openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/fleet-pki/private/fleet-internal-ca.key -out /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -subj '/CN=Fleet Internal CA' -extensions v3_ca -config /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf
fi
sudo cp /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/fleet-internal-ca.crt
sudo update-ca-certificates
printf 'CA_SUBJECT='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -noout -subject
printf 'CA_ISSUER='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -noout -issuer
printf 'CA_CONSTRAINTS='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -noout -text | grep -A1 'Basic Constraints'
printf 'CA_TRUST='; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt
commands.stdout:

1 added, 0 removed; done.
Running hooks in /etc/ca-certificates/update.d...
done.

CA_CONSTRAINTS=            X509v3 Basic Constraints: 
                CA:TRUE
CA_TRUST=/etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt: OK

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 700 /etc/fleet-tls/private
sudo install -d -m 755 /etc/fleet-tls/certs /etc/fleet-tls/www
if [ ! -s /etc/fleet-tls/private/node2.key ]; then
  sudo openssl genrsa -out /etc/fleet-tls/private/node2.key 2048
  sudo chmod 600 /etc/fleet-tls/private/node2.key
fi
sudo sh -c "cat > /etc/fleet-tls/node2-req.cnf" <<EOF
[req]
prompt = no
distinguished_name = dn
req_extensions = req_ext
[dn]
CN = node2
[req_ext]
subjectAltName = @alt_names
keyUsage = critical, digitalSignature, keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth
[alt_names]
DNS.1 = node2
IP.1 = $NODE_IP
EOF
sudo openssl req -new -sha256 -key /etc/fleet-tls/private/node2.key -out /etc/fleet-tls/node2.csr -config /etc/fleet-tls/node2-req.cnf
printf 'CSR_SUBJECT='; openssl req -in /etc/fleet-tls/node2.csr -noout -subject
printf 'CSR_SANS='; openssl req -in /etc/fleet-tls/node2.csr -noout -text | grep -A1 'Subject Alternative Name'
printf 'CSR_BASE64='; base64 -w0 /etc/fleet-tls/node2.csr; printf '\n'
commands.stdout:
CSR_SUBJECT=subject=/CN=node2
CSR_SANS=            X509v3 Subject Alternative Name: 
                DNS:node2, IP Address:10.100.136.11
[REDACTED_ENCODED_BLOB]

commands.command:

printf '%s' '[REDACTED_ENCODED_BLOB]' | base64 -d | sudo tee /etc/fleet-pki/node2.csr >/dev/null
sudo sh -c "cat > /etc/fleet-pki/node2-ext.cnf" <<'EOF'
basicConstraints = critical,CA:FALSE
keyUsage = critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth
subjectAltName = @alt_names
[alt_names]
DNS.1 = node2
IP.1 = 10.100.136.11
EOF
sudo openssl x509 -req -sha256 -days 825 -in /etc/fleet-pki/node2.csr -CA /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/fleet-pki/private/fleet-internal-ca.key -CAcreateserial -CAserial /etc/fleet-pki/fleet-internal-ca.srl -out /etc/fleet-pki/certs/node2.crt -extfile /etc/fleet-pki/node2-ext.cnf
printf 'CERT_SUBJECT='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-pki/certs/node2.crt -noout -subject
printf 'CERT_ISSUER='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-pki/certs/node2.crt -noout -issuer
printf 'CERT_SANS='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-pki/certs/node2.crt -noout -text | grep -A1 'Subject Alternative Name'
printf 'CHAIN_VERIFY='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt /etc/fleet-pki/certs/node2.crt
printf 'CERT_BASE64='; base64 -w0 /etc/fleet-pki/certs/node2.crt; printf '\n'
printf 'CA_BASE64='; base64 -w0 /etc/fleet-pki/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt; printf '\n'

set -eu

sleep 1
ss -ltnp | grep '10.100.136.10:18080'

set -eu
sudo curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.100.136.10:18080/node2.crt -o /etc/fleet-tls/certs/node2.crt
sudo curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.100.136.10:18080/fleet-internal-ca.crt -o /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/fleet-internal-ca.crt
sudo cp /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/fleet-internal-ca.crt /etc/fleet-tls/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt
sudo chmod 644 /etc/fleet-tls/certs/node2.crt /etc/fleet-tls/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/fleet-internal-ca.crt
sudo update-ca-certificates
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-tls/certs/node2.crt -noout -pubkey | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
key_pub=$(sudo openssl pkey -in /etc/fleet-tls/private/node2.key -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
printf 'CERT_KEY_MATCH=%s\n' "$([ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ] && printf yes || printf no)"

printf 'CERT_IDENTITY='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-tls/certs/node2.crt -noout -subject -issuer
printf 'CERT_SANS='; openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-tls/certs/node2.crt -noout -text | grep -A1 'Subject Alternative Name'
